android.desc: VoicePing gives you a Walkie Talkie App for long range walkie talkie. You can walkie talkie in a group or to an individual no matter how far they are from you even if their phone is locked. Enjoy texting, picture and video messaging unified in one app. Walkie Talkie Long Range Communication ► When you work as a team, voice communication enables you to get things done faster. ► VoicePing App allows you to get your voice to your entire team no matter how far they are from you. ► Fast Sub second U.S. based server for best walkie talkie experience. ► Send and hear instant voice messages from your colleagues even if the app is in the background or your phone is locked. ► Texting, picture and video messaging unified on one screen. ► Communicate in Groups and Private channels to get work done faster ► You can see where everyone is with location maps (GPS) both on mobile and web desktop. ► Page or send SOS so you can get help quickly. ► Desktop Version available for a more seamless communication between in-office and field workers ► Multi platform support on Android, iOS and Web Desktop ► Professional Walkie Talkie Phones and Bluetooth Accessories supported for ease of use. Free Forever for Public and Personal Use ► Thousands of Public Channels: Choose from 9999 public channels. Unlimited people can join. ► Family Channel: Request own private Channel in app. Only your family can join your private channel. 5 free users. 「Enterprise Channels」: Unlimited Private Channels. All channels are private. All users are controlled via administrative tool. Enterprise Features – 1 Enterprise Directory: Easy to find colleagues and add as contacts – 2 Private Domain: We do not allow anybody to join your walkie talkie channel other than your co-workers – 3 Admin Portal: Allows the administrator to Add, Manage & Remove users. – 4 Web Desktop: Give your telephone operator, dispatchers or managers in the office the ability to send text and walkie talkie via desktop web. – 5 Recordings: Download all messages within a specified time from the Server via the Admin Dashboard. (Read) – 6 Bluetooth Support: Bluetooth Walkie Talkie App Headsets are supported & compatible on the VoicePing Enterprise App – 7 API: Access Access to our API if you need to integrate with your systems. – 8 Support: We provide technical support via phone & email during Business Days/Hours. – 9 SLA: We provide a 99.95% Service Level Agreement to

quotes.text:
Can I make my laptop to be a walkie talkie?
Can I make my phone to be a walkie talkie?
Yes, you can do that! Without paying anything.
Go to https://web.voiceoverping.net if you don't believe. 
Or download on your android phone: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.media2359.voiceping.store
Or download on your iOS phone: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/voiceping/id1249953303?ls=1&mt=8

Type 4 digits channel ID you want to join. Click Join Channel.
On the other devices do the same. Now tada talk as long as you want!
